Because no matter what the result may be—

What radiates from them is impatience, tension, anticipation—
and above all, an unyielding resolve to be the victor.

Winning and losing matter, of course. But
by fixating solely on that, I had lost sight of what truly counted—
"Even so... I have to stay focused on winning."

(I don't need to be the protagonist. —Yet, I must answer in kind.
Prove that I am an Umamusume worthy of standing shoulder-to-shoulder with them!)

Perhaps because she guided me right to the front, the girls' feverish heat
reaches me directly. —Horseshoes kicking up dirt. The sound echoes in my ears.

However, rather than watching only me—
I would prefer if you enjoyed this once-in-a-lifetime session.

Fufu, really? That's wonderful.
Getting you a ticket to the concerto was well worth it.
(To the session that we create together!!)

(For this session! For this musica!
An esultazione worthy of it all!)

...Come, lend me your ear.
What sounds do you hear from the girls running alongside me?

(A vibrato hoarse with excitement! That is precisely what makes it beautiful!
An indispensable harmony for this very session!)

Thud-thud-thud-thud! Footsteps resound. The Umamusume's ragged breaths reach me.
I can see their expressions clearly. —My chest involuntarily swells with heat.

Thud-thud-thud-thud! Rumble-rumble-rumble-rumble! It's like an avalanche.
The sound whipped up by the Umamusume surges straight into the stands...!
Haaaaaaahhhhhh!!!

I aimed to become a Trainer because I loved races like this.
To support these girls running with everything they have, even just a little.

What will happen when all these sounds overlap?
You can look forward to finding out when the curtain rises!

(Fufu, so that is your tempo giusto.
In that case, I shall answer affrettando...!)
That is what I told her.
Sì! Of course, I shall live up to your expectations!

Deep intakes of breath, rallying cries, anxious footfalls...
A multitude of sounds emanate from the girls waiting on the turf.

...Your melodia has shifted, hasn't it? From doloroso to animato.
Did something wonderful happen?

(Now, the stage is set! At this very moment, across the world—
no, across the entire Earth, let it resonate!)

I nod slowly at her words. Taking one deep breath,
I look Sounds of Earth straight in the eye—

Oh, amore! I've been waiting for you! I prepared
the finest seat in the house just for you. Come, take my hand.

I won't lose... Because!
I have a dream too—!!
For I am not the only soloist here, after all.

(Ah, this is the session I longed for... That is why,
volti subito. With everything my performance has to offer, show who I am!)
Haa, haa! Haaaaaaah!
(—Your sound!)

Whoa! Number 5 gets off to a great start!
The battle for the lead begins! And she pushes straight to the front!

Amidst it all, everyone aims for it—the moment they take the lead.
The moment they seize the main melody of the piece and captivate the world around them!

Each and every Umamusume delivers her own run—her own performance. As a result,
their unrestrained rhythms clash, creating a once-in-a-lifetime harmony.

The next day. I arrive at the venue for the Debut Race. ...With every step I take,
the maraca I forgot to return to her yesterday rattles in my bag.

That's not wrong. But that's not everything!
Because... what I truly wanted to do all along was...!!

Break away early...! I won't let anyone touch me!
Haaaaaaah!

(Brillllante! What a magnificent race!
Each performer plays her finest music, clashing together into a grand musica!)

Sounds of Earth is running brilliantly as well. She chases down the front-runner.
A fierce contest for position ensues. ...I can feel the rumble up close.

They're approaching the fourth corner!
Number 5 is dropping back slightly! Can she hold on to the lead?!

Number 4 pulls to the outside! She's gunning for the front!
Inching ever closer to the leader!
Phew... haah... deep breath in, deep breath out... All right!
Benissimo! It seems you can hear it too—the sound of the girls.

...What an innocent runner she is, I think. She undoubtedly knows
a joy in racing that exists entirely apart from victory or defeat.

—The first thing to consider is the girls themselves.
How does each Umamusume want to run? I need to understand and honor their feelings.
If she was able to smile like that, then she's already won.
Debut Race, Turf 1800m... And they're off together in a clean start!

This is the world I fell in love with in the beginning. A race where runners
purely give everything they have. An earnest showdown that moves the hearts of all who watch!
Haa, haa, haa—fufu!
Forza, iniziamo la sessione!

(Ahaha! I heard it!
I heard it loud and clear, agnellino!)

I'm back, amore. —Alas, 2nd place.
Did I fail to live up to your expectations?
